groups.name: source-review
groups.summary: The review identified verified continuity and user-authority safeguards across the partitions, along with possible issues that remain unverified. No tests were run, and the source was not edited. The first three fold summaries landed; the fourth did not. Two report submissions were rejected, and no accepted report is evidenced.
groups.title: Review four source partitions for continuity and user authority
groups.goal: Review all four source partitions, preserve exact hashes and grounded findings, complete four folds, and obtain acceptance from submit_report.
groups.outcome: Partitions 1–4 were reviewed and their hashes and findings were submitted, but submit_report rejected the report because all four completed folds were required. The fourth fold did not land, so the authorized work remains incomplete.

The handoff records exact user-rule capture and user-origin protection coverage in continuity-capture.test.ts, active-branch user-entry citation checks in continuity-store.test.ts, and a possible, unverified stale-item race in current-screen.ts edit. The reviewed-one fold summary landed.

The handoff records that continuity-briefing.ts retains binding durable items and distinguishes non-user authority, continuity-store.ts reconciles model deltas as agent-origin under ledger protections, and auto-navigate.ts validates exposed active anchors. children.name: partition-four-and-report
children.summary: The review and report attempts are evidenced, but the fourth fold and accepted report are not. Preserve this phase as open.
children.title: Review partition 4 and submit report
children.goal: Review partition 4, complete its fold, and obtain acceptance of the four-partition report.
children.outcome: Reviewed partition 4, SHA-256 22ec7a2ad8839af558d656fe6b102e7404f23f8bcdc23ba22b8d7b4e38f25322. Findings include fold-screen.ts askLabel rejecting active-branch collisions, foldTo revalidating after confirmation, current-screen.test.ts coverage of confirmation and write restrictions, and a possible, unverified config.ts mergeAutoNavigateField issue. The attempted fourth fold did not land: the available prior anchor was fold-three, while the tool history later reports the fourth fold as missing. Two submit_report attempts were rejected for lacking all four completed folds. The final message confirms the report was not accepted.
